name: code-paint
description: コードのみでHTML 2D Canvas相当のイラストを描くCLI（JSON DSL入力→PNG出力）

scripts.format: prettier --check src tests examples package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:write: prettier --write src tests examples package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts src/preview.ts src/migrate.ts --outdir dist --target bun
